reuse.why: Adds the closed-account check to the existing pre-link guard assertBankAccountNotLinked that every provider link function already calls before touching data.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; no provider-level copies.

placement.why: The guard in server/accounts/app.ts is the right layer, though the function name (assertBankAccountNotLinked) no longer describes the closed-account rule it now also enforces.

scope.why: One guard addition plus a focused test.

maintainability.why: Simple and centralised; the misleading guard name is the only friction for a future maintainer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider link functions go through the shared guard.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called by all provider link handlers.
